opponent_families.name: single_flag_economic_raid
opponent_families.independent_mechanism: Build an enemy-W-arrival-aware weighted grid graph; send one expendable F through a low-contact route to opponent ENG or HALL. Separate ordinary expansion from the raider; no v3 policy or evaluation call.
opponent_families.evidence: round2 Newbies and Red Coral single-F traces
required_events: F raider follows a legal >=3-step off-center route
arrives at an economy building without allied W on the arrival tile
can abort when its route becomes intercepted
opponent_families.not_claimed: Not an implementation or reconstruction of either official opponent.

opponent_families.name: dual_deadline_economic_raid
opponent_families.independent_mechanism: Choose two distinct F origins and targets using a two-task arrival-time assignment; schedule a one-turn launch delay or wait so two fronts threaten within 0..2 turns. Use shared production and movement pools.
opponent_families.evidence: round2 Shinchon ENG t23 / HALL t24
required_events: two distinct fronts threaten different economy buildings within two turns
no raider or production resource double-counting
force response at both deadlines rather than merely chasing the closest F

opponent_families.name: economy_hospital_concentration
opponent_families.independent_mechanism: Finite-state plan: secure one ENG -> forward HOSPITAL -> rally F+W at one objective -> relocate production and repeat. Use force arrival thresholds and minimal local rear guard, not global v3 building-value maximization.
opponent_families.evidence: economic-production associations in both rounds; f3 failed reserve sacrifice of enemy HOSPITAL pressure
required_events: synchronized F/W arrival at one target
owned forward hospital is actually used for production
an enemy economic target is pressed after own economy is secured

opponent_families.name: equal_force_contest_reclaim_relay
opponent_families.independent_mechanism: Event-driven controller routes replacement F separately from W. At W equality it sends/holds F to contest; after neutralization it books recapture cost and a backup F. It replans from new ownership, not from a copied fixed opponent action trace.
opponent_families.evidence: round1 terminal W3+F defense and repeated ENG flips; prior j_reclaim regression
required_events: W equality plus surviving F creates contest
a neutralized building is retargeted before an unrelated low-value expansion
same physical W and teleport budget are shared across all tasks

opponent_families.name: terminal_multi_target_flip
opponent_families.independent_mechanism: Use a time-expanded small assignment only in the last H turns. Enumerate legal F/W joint arrival packages and PRIORITY; compare actual terminal score, then occupation, then unit tiebreak. No credit for income or units that cannot affect the horizon.
opponent_families.evidence: round2 tAIger t158..160 and round1 final WATCH neutralization
required_events: two or more buildings are attacked/contested in the final two turns
enemy ownership can be neutralized without completing own capture
resource shortage changes PRIORITY rather than overspending

opponent_families.name: bait_switch_and_repeat_raid
opponent_families.independent_mechanism: A small state machine chooses between a raid and central pressure using public defender commitment. After one or two defenders respond it can reverse route, wait, or switch targets; when defense leaves, re-enter. Fixed seed controls only tie-breaking.
opponent_families.evidence: stress hypothesis, not a measured official-opponent tactic; f3 8714 actual enemy F turned away while own attack was also abandoned
required_events: target changes after visible defense commitment
defender pursuit is distinguishable from interception at a fixed cut
repeat raid attacks a newly emptied protected building

rule_and_trace_fixtures.case: Newbies t10 F route toward HALL; W2 (3,7)
rule_and_trace_fixtures.expected: Generate an interception route by t13 at (3,10), if affordable; do not certify a t14 repair that is already late.
Include W1 down/down/down and correctly reject the visually near route through wall (3,12).

rule_and_trace_fixtures.case: Shinchon t18, resource12, Wcost2; two raiders
rule_and_trace_fixtures.expected: Consider W2 production at base plus split routes, not only hospital production; credit only defenders arriving by each deadline.
Cancel costly defensive reservation while preserving legal attack commitments; cancellation must be driven by current public state, not future replay.

rule_and_trace_fixtures.case: W arrives after economy building becomes neutral
rule_and_trace_fixtures.expected: Create F recovery job and account for its ETA and capture budget; W-only arrival is not counted as recovered ownership.

rule_and_trace_fixtures.case: Our W3, their W3+F1, our adjacent F1 at turn159
rule_and_trace_fixtures.expected: Joint W stay + F enter keeps owned building contested; W stay alone fails. Test exact official transition.

rule_and_trace_fixtures.case: Friendly weak F on owned building is killed
rule_and_trace_fixtures.expected: Compare same-turn enemy capture after combat neutralization against slower capture of an empty owned building.

rule_and_trace_fixtures.case: Two economic threats but only one timely W
rule_and_trace_fixtures.expected: One W cannot satisfy both simultaneous deadlines; report infeasible task and choose real tradeoff.

rule_and_trace_fixtures.case: Two or three terminal captures, budget below sum
rule_and_trace_fixtures.expected: Use PRIORITY and library snapshot order correctly; future depot bonus cannot fund same-turn captures.

rule_and_trace_fixtures.case: f3 8714 t60 defense and enemy hospital attack
rule_and_trace_fixtures.expected: Keep option combining HALL W1 reserve AND separate F1/W7 hospital attack; they are compatible. Never infer whole-game win from one-turn change.

rule_and_trace_fixtures.case: Own base/new hospital production excluded by existing pre-production top4
rule_and_trace_fixtures.expected: Urgent source generation considers legal spawn sites with no preexisting unit; record emergency slot and effect on old candidate count.

rule_and_trace_fixtures.case: Two-origin convergence unhelpful one origin at a time
rule_and_trace_fixtures.expected: Generate both F/W changes as a complete joint command; evaluate complete base and new candidate under identical modeled opponents.

rule_and_trace_fixtures.case: 158-turn score lead; simultaneous losses and gain
rule_and_trace_fixtures.expected: Evaluate total final-board score across all contested buildings; economic bonuses cannot outrank a provable terminal point advantage.

rule_and_trace_fixtures.case: Hidden score still -1 and mirrored partner unknown
rule_and_trace_fixtures.expected: Use only legal bounds consistent with symmetric pair; no hindsight score, future enemy action or replay-only information.

rule_and_trace_fixtures.case: Teleport plus two tasks; newly arriving troops
rule_and_trace_fixtures.expected: One valid TELE, max5, pre-move origin pool; newly arriving troops cannot move again this turn.
Discard partial candidate, retain last fully evaluated legal incumbent, record incomplete reason and deadline margin.

criteria.status: proposed_before_implementation; must be frozen in a run manifest before selection/final results
criteria.baseline: immutable local v4; v3 is diagnostic official predecessor
criteria.primary_metric: macro mean of family Y win+0.5draw rates; equal weight per family and per locked profile within family
performance_gates: Final paired map-bootstrap 95% lower bound of macro Y improvement over v4 is greater than zero.
Point Y score rate in every new family is at least 0.50; no family point regression versus v4 worse than 0.05.
Held-out policy families A4/A6 pooled Y improvement is nonnegative; each family remains separately reported.
Historical-group macro Y 95% lower confidence bound of difference is at least -0.03; no historical opponent point regression worse than 0.05.
K is a symmetry/generalization check: macro point difference must be at least -0.05; a Y gain must not be relabeled universal improvement.
Fresh audit macro Y difference is positive and no family point regression worse than 0.05. No replacing the selected candidate based on audit outcome.
safety_gates: zero engine-invalid commands, errors, output violations or forfeits
all mandatory reachable microcases pass the exact expected local transition
actual ZIP tested with GCC12.2 under 384MiB memory and normal300ms/first3000ms protocol limits
runtime gate calibrated before tuning on the same benchmark machine; reserve explicit headroom because previous official v3 normal max was276ms
criteria.uncertainty: These are proposed release goals, not evidence already passed; map-resampled CIs condition on fixed policy families and cannot quantify unknown official-team strength.

sample_plan.formula: maps * (6 independent families*2 profiles +4 historical opponents) *2 sides *2 tested programs(v4,selected candidate)
sample_plan.seed_manifest: Not yet allocated. Before any run, draw disjoint integer map/policy seeds; check historical seed overlap AND map hash overlap. Official18 and all previously analyzed maps are development only. More games on one map do not create independent maps.

instrumentation: legal observation hash, actual turn input/output alignment, own and model full-action hashes
threat id and target; earliest enemy F arrival lower bound, plausible path; threat uncertainty vs committed prediction
defender/spawn source ETA, shared resource and W/F pool; chosen deadline slack; why a task is infeasible
candidate source inclusion/exclusion rank, emergency slot, generation/cleaning/complete-evaluation counts
four original policy predictions vs new model predictions; model values, modeled minimum gain, acceptance/rejection code
same-budget baseline chosen action, continuation, actual completed transition count, base65ms effect
defense diversion and compatible attack opportunity; cancelled assignment; F recapture arrival time
actual next-state ownership/F survival error without claiming unique enemy command reconstruction
terminal score bounds, capture cost and PRIORITY effect, instant-win condition and tiebreak feasibility
time per stage, memory, incomplete candidate fallback, all output legality issues

diversity_gate.policy_sharing: protocol/parser/official transition may be shared; v2/v3 policy/evaluation/target allocator must not be copied into new independent opponents
diversity_gate.behavior_requirement: Each family executes its declared legal events on at least two purpose-built fixture geometries, with outcome-independent fixture selection. Every mandatory event must occur at least once. Failure means the opponent family is not counted, regardless of how many parameter variants exist.
diversity_gate.full_game_coverage: Report per-family eligible games, actual triggered games, failed attempts and no-op fallback count. If fewer than16 eligible development maps exercise the signature, collect extra development maps before freezing selection; never mine final maps for difficult examples.
diversity_gate.distance: Across the frozen identical-state corpus report canonical full-action disagreement and event fingerprint distances; target >=10% disagreement for claimed different implementations, but a same-action percentage alone cannot establish strategic diversity.
diversity_gate.holdout: A4/A6 complete opponent policies are frozen before candidate development, never used for candidate selection, first evaluated in final. Their design primitives are known, so this is held-out-policy evaluation, not genuinely unknown-algorithm proof.

failure_limits: observed team may change algorithms or have multiple modes
a hypothesis opponent is not a clone of an observed team
fixed adversaries can overfit in both directions; equally weak distinct policies are still insufficient
finite seeds do not prove universal winning or an equilibrium
robust worst-case modes can become too passive when physically incompatible enemy attacks are combined
root collecting new public data may expand replay census; it does not retroactively make these18 complete
